<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Forum&family=Source+Sans+3:wght@400;600&display=swap">
<style>

.bz{--page:#F5EEE4;--white:#FFFFFF;--ink:#2A1812;--ink-soft:#5E4E44;--brown:#5C2B1D;--brown-2:#6B3424;--brown-dark:#2B1711;--cream:#F4E6D0;--cream-soft:rgba(244,230,208,.88);--gold:#D4B27A;--maroon:#6E1423;--maroon-600:#8A1D30;--line:rgba(42,24,18,.12);--line-d:rgba(244,230,208,.18);
--f-head:'Forum','Times New Roman',serif;--f-body:'Source Sans 3',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif;
--r-panel:36px;--r-card:24px;--r-md:18px;--r-pill:999px;--sh:0 18px 44px -18px rgba(43,23,17,.35);
background:var(--page);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:17px;line-height:1.65;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow:hidden}
.bz *{box-sizing:border-box}
.bz img{max-width:100%;display:block}
.bz h1,.bz h2,.bz h3{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:400;line-height:1.16;margin:0;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em}
.bz p{margin:0}
.bz a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.bz h1,.bz h2,.bz h3{color:inherit}
.bz .wrap{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
.bz section{padding:14px 0}
.bz .panel{border-radius:var(--r-panel);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.bz .on-brown{background:var(--brown);color:var(--cream)}
.bz .on-white{background:var(--white)}
.bz .pad{padding:72px 56px}
@media(max-width:860px){.bz .pad{padding:44px 22px}.bz .panel{border-radius:28px}}
.bz h2{font-size:clamp(26px,3.6vw,42px);margin:0 0 16px}
.bz .rule{display:block;width:96px;height:2px;background:var(--gold);margin-bottom:22px;border-radius:2px}
.bz .lead{color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:640px}
.bz .on-brown .lead{color:var(--cream-soft)}
.bz .head{margin-bottom:40px}

/* buttons */
.bz .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:6px 6px 6px 26px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:var(--maroon);color:#fff;font:600 14px/1 var(--f-body);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid var(--maroon);transition:background .2s,transform .2s}
.bz .btn::after{content:"↗";display:grid;place-items:center;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);color:var(--brown-dark);font-size:16px;letter-spacing:0;transition:transform .2s}
.bz .btn:hover{background:var(--maroon-600);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.bz .btn:hover::after{transform:rotate(45deg)}
.bz .btn.ghost{background:transparent;border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--cream)}
.bz .btn.ghost:hover{background:rgba(212,178,122,.12)}
.bz .btn.sm{padding:4px 4px 4px 20px;font-size:12px}.bz .btn.sm::after{width:34px;height:34px;font-size:14px}
.bz .on-white .btn.ghost,.bz .btn.ghost.dark{color:var(--maroon);border-color:var(--maroon)}

/* hero */
.bz .hero{padding-top:20px}
.bz .hero-panel{background:var(--brown-dark);color:var(--cream)}
.bz .nav{position:relative;z-index:3;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;padding:22px 44px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-d);background:rgba(43,23,17,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.bz .logo{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:22px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;color:var(--cream)}
.bz .nav ul{display:flex;gap:30px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}
.bz .nav ul a{text-decoration:none;color:var(--cream-soft)}
.bz .nav ul a:hover{color:var(--gold)}
.bz .hero-body{position:relative;min-height:600px;display:flex;align-items:center}
.bz .hero-media{position:absolute;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;left:36%}
.bz .hero-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 12%}
.bz .hero-media::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--brown-dark) 0,rgba(43,23,17,.55) 28%,rgba(92,43,29,.18) 60%,rgba(92,43,29,.12) 100%)}
.bz .hero-copy{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:64px 56px;max-width:660px}
.bz .hero h1{font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,50px);line-height:1.18;margin:0 0 22px;color:var(--cream)}
.bz .hero h1 span{color:var(--gold)}
.bz .hero .lead{color:var(--cream-soft);margin-bottom:34px}
.bz .cta-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
@media(max-width:860px){
  .bz .hero{padding-top:12px}
  .bz .nav{padding:14px 18px}.bz .nav ul{display:none}.bz .logo{font-size:17px;letter-spacing:.1em}
  .bz .hero-body{display:block;min-height:0}
  .bz .hero-media{position:relative;left:0;height:440px}
  .bz .hero-media img{object-position:50% 8%}
  .bz .hero-media::before{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(43,23,17,.0) 38%,rgba(43,23,17,.82) 80%,var(--brown-dark) 100%)}
  .bz .hero-copy{margin-top:-150px;padding:0 22px 40px;max-width:none}
  .bz .hero h1{font-size:clamp(27px,7.6vw,36px)}
  .bz .cta-row .btn{width:100%;justify-content:space-between}
}

/* about */
.bz .about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.8fr 1fr .9fr;gap:40px;align-items:start}
.bz .about-photo{border-radius:var(--r-card);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh);aspect-ratio:4/3.4}
.bz .about-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 20%}
.bz .about p.txt{color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:14px}
.bz .chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:18px 0 0}
.bz .chip{font-size:13px;padding:7px 15px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-pill);color:var(--ink-soft)}
.bz .chip.on{border-color:var(--maroon);color:var(--maroon);font-weight:600}
.bz .help{background:var(--brown);color:var(--cream);border-radius:var(--r-card);padding:34px 30px}
.bz .help h3{font-size:22px;margin-bottom:12px;color:var(--cream)}
.bz .help p{color:var(--cream-soft);margin-bottom:22px;font-size:16px}
@media(max-width:980px){.bz .about-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.bz .about-photo{grid-column:1/-1;aspect-ratio:16/10}}
@media(max-width:640px){.bz .about-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:26px}.bz .about-photo{aspect-ratio:4/3.3}}

/* services */
.bz .svc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}
.bz .svc{background:rgba(244,230,208,.06);border:1px solid var(--line-d);border-radius:var(--r-card);padding:30px 28px;transition:background .2s,transform .2s}
.bz .svc:hover{background:rgba(244,230,208,.11);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.bz .ico{width:46px;height:46px;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:22px}
.bz .svc h3{font-size:20px;margin-bottom:10px;color:var(--cream)}
.bz .svc p{color:var(--cream-soft);font-size:16px}
.bz .more{display:inline-block;margin-top:16px;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(212,178,122,.5)}
@media(max-width:980px){.bz .svc-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:620px){.bz .svc-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px}.bz .svc{padding:24px 22px}}

/* results */
.bz .res-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}
.bz .res{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-card);padding:16px 16px 26px;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.bz .res-photo{aspect-ratio:16/10;border-radius:var(--r-md);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E9D9C2,#F6EEE2);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:14px;margin-bottom:20px;border:1px dashed rgba(42,24,18,.22)}
.bz .res h3{font-size:19px;margin:0 8px 8px}
.bz .res p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:16px;margin:0 8px}
@media(max-width:860px){.bz .res-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px}}

/* reviews */
.bz .quote-mark{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:72px;line-height:.6;color:var(--gold);display:block;margin-bottom:10px}
.bz .rev-slot{border:1px dashed var(--line-d);border-radius:var(--r-card);padding:48px 24px;text-align:center;color:var(--cream-soft);background:rgba(244,230,208,.05)}
.bz .rev-slot b{display:block;font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:400;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;font-size:20px;color:var(--cream);margin-bottom:6px}

/* footer / contacts */
.bz .footer-panel{background:var(--brown-dark);color:var(--cream);display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr}
.bz .info{padding:56px 52px}
.bz .links{display:grid;gap:12px;margin-top:26px}
.bz .links a{display:block;text-decoration:none;padding:15px 20px;border:1px solid var(--line-d);border-radius:var(--r-md);background:rgba(244,230,208,.05);transition:background .2s}
.bz .links a:hover{background:rgba(244,230,208,.11)}
.bz .links small{display:block;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold)}
.bz .links b{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:400;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:.03em}
.bz .hours{margin-top:22px;padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-d);font-size:16px;color:var(--cream-soft)}
.bz .hours b{color:var(--cream);font-weight:600}
.bz .map{min-height:420px;padding:14px 14px 14px 0}
.bz .map iframe{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:392px;border:0;display:block;border-radius:var(--r-card)}
@media(max-width:860px){.bz .footer-panel{grid-template-columns:1fr}.bz .info{padding:38px 22px 26px}.bz .map{padding:0 14px 14px;min-height:320px}.bz .map iframe{min-height:300px}}
.bz .foot{padding:22px 4px 34px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-soft)}

.bz{width:100%;margin:0;min-height:100vh}
html,body{margin:0!important;padding:0!important;background:#F5EEE4!important}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}


/* results heading highlight */
.bz .res-panel{box-shadow:0 18px 44px -22px rgba(43,23,17,.35);border:1px solid rgba(212,178,122,.55);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff 0,#FBF6EE 100%)}
.bz .res-head{text-align:center;margin-bottom:44px}
.bz .res-head .lead{margin:0 auto}
.bz .res-badge{display:inline-block;margin-bottom:16px;padding:7px 18px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--maroon);color:#fff;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600}
.bz .res-title{font-size:clamp(32px,5vw,58px);margin:0 0 18px;color:var(--brown)}
.bz .res-title span{display:inline;padding:0 .18em;background:linear-gradient(transparent 62%,rgba(212,178,122,.6) 62%);-webkit-box-decoration-break:clone;box-decoration-break:clone}
.bz .res-title::after{content:"";display:block;width:96px;height:3px;margin:18px auto 0;border-radius:3px;background:var(--maroon)}
@media(max-width:860px){.bz .res-head{margin-bottom:30px}}
/* results v2: vertical grid, no horizontal scroll */
.bz .res-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px}
.bz .res{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;padding:12px 12px 22px}
.bz .res-photo{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;padding:0;margin:0 0 16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-md);overflow:hidden;background:#fff;cursor:zoom-in;position:relative}
.bz .res-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 0;transition:transform .35s}
.bz .res-photo:hover img{transform:scale(1.03)}
.bz .res-photo::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:46px;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(255,255,255,.9),rgba(255,255,255,0))}
.bz .res h3{font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.25;margin:0 6px 8px}
.bz .res p{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.55;margin:0 6px;color:var(--ink-soft)}
@media(max-width:1100px){.bz .res-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:620px){.bz .res-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px}.bz .res-photo{aspect-ratio:4/5}.bz .res h3{font-size:18px}.bz .res p{font-size:15.5px}}
.lb{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99999;background:rgba(20,10,6,.88);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px;overflow:auto}
.lb[hidden]{display:none}
.lb img{max-width:min(920px,100%);max-height:100%;width:auto;height:auto;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.lb-x{position:fixed;top:14px;right:18px;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);background:rgba(0,0,0,.4);color:#fff;font-size:28px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer}
/* reviews v2: vertical masonry columns */
.bz .rv-grid{column-count:3;column-gap:18px}
.bz .rv{break-inside:avoid;margin:0 0 18px;padding:24px 24px 20px;border:1px solid var(--line-d);border-radius:var(--r-card);background:rgba(244,230,208,.07)}
.bz .rv-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px}
.bz .rv-st{color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.12em;font-size:17px}
.bz .rv-date{font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(244,230,208,.6)}
.bz .rv blockquote{margin:0 0 16px;font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--cream)}
.bz .rv figcaption{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-d);padding-top:12px}
.bz .rv figcaption b{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:400;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--cream)}
.bz .rv figcaption span{font-size:13.5px;color:rgba(244,230,208,.65)}
.bz .demo-note{margin-top:22px;padding:12px 16px;border:1px dashed var(--gold);border-radius:14px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--cream-soft);text-align:center}
@media(max-width:1000px){.bz .rv-grid{column-count:2}}
@media(max-width:640px){.bz .rv-grid{column-count:1}.bz .rv{padding:20px 18px 16px}}

/* results page */
.bz .rp-hero{background:var(--brown-dark);color:var(--cream)}
.bz .rp-hero .nav ul a.cur{color:var(--gold)}
.bz .rp-head{position:relative;text-align:center;padding:76px 28px 84px;max-width:860px;margin:0 auto}
.bz .rp-head .res-badge{background:var(--gold);color:var(--brown-dark)}
.bz .rp-head h1{font-size:clamp(34px,5.4vw,64px);line-height:1.1;margin:0 0 20px;color:var(--cream)}
.bz .rp-head h1 span{color:var(--gold)}
.bz .rp-head h1::after{content:"";display:block;width:110px;height:3px;margin:22px auto 0;border-radius:3px;background:var(--gold)}
.bz .rp-head .lead{color:var(--cream-soft);margin:0 auto 12px;max-width:680px}
.bz .rp-count{display:inline-flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-top:10px;padding:8px 18px;border:1px solid var(--line-d);border-radius:999px;font-size:13.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cream-soft)}
.bz .rp-count b{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:400;font-size:22px;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:0}
.bz .rp-list{box-shadow:0 18px 44px -22px rgba(43,23,17,.35);border:1px solid rgba(212,178,122,.55)}
.bz .rp-list .res-grid{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:18px}
.bz .rp-list .res{flex:0 0 calc(25% - 13.5px)}
.bz .res h2{font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.25;margin:0 6px 8px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em}
@media(max-width:1100px){.bz .rp-list .res{flex-basis:calc(50% - 9px)}}
@media(max-width:620px){.bz .rp-list .res{flex-basis:100%}.bz .res h2{font-size:18px}.bz .rp-head{padding:54px 8px 60px}}
.bz .rp-cta{background:var(--brown);color:var(--cream);text-align:center}
.bz .rp-cta h2{color:var(--cream);margin-bottom:14px}
.bz .rp-cta .lead{margin:0 auto 28px;color:var(--cream-soft)}

/* Сторінки «Контакти» і «Політика конфіденційності» + оновлений футер (S1 Mahogany). Додається до bz.css. */
.bz .sec-gap{padding:14px 0}
.bz .ct-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}
.bz .ct-card{display:block;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-card);padding:26px 26px 28px;box-shadow:var(--sh);transition:transform .2s}
.bz a.ct-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.bz .ct-card small{display:block;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--maroon);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px}
.bz .ct-card b{display:block;font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:400;font-size:21px;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--ink);word-break:break-word}
.bz .ct-card p{margin-top:8px;font-size:15px;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.bz .map-panel{padding:14px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.bz .map-panel iframe{display:block;width:100%;height:440px;border:0;border-radius:24px}
.bz .soc-head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin-bottom:30px}
.bz .soc-head h2{color:var(--cream);margin:0}
.bz .soc-head p{color:var(--cream-soft);max-width:420px}
.bz .soc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:16px}
.bz .soc{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:18px 20px;border:1px solid var(--line-d);border-radius:22px;background:rgba(244,230,208,.06);transition:background .2s}
.bz .soc:hover{background:rgba(244,230,208,.13)}
.bz .soc-ico{flex:0 0 52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);color:var(--brown-dark);display:grid;place-items:center}
.bz .soc-ico svg{width:24px;height:24px;fill:currentColor}
.bz .soc small{display:block;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold)}
.bz .soc b{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:400;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:.03em;color:var(--cream)}
/* політика */
.bz .legal-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:260px 1fr;gap:40px;align-items:start}
.bz .toc{position:sticky;top:20px;padding:22px 22px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-card);background:var(--page)}
.bz .toc b{display:block;font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:400;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;font-size:16px;margin-bottom:10px;color:var(--ink)}
.bz .toc a{display:block;padding:5px 0;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.35}
